title: Pulsar APX Portable Vaporizer V3 (taxes extra)
description:
The Pulsar APX V3 Vape

ALSO AVAILABLE:
PULSAR APX PRO

The Pulsar APX series is a proven classic affordable portable dry herb vaporizer.
Version 3 brings new designs, better performance and a bigger bowl.

The new and improved APX V3 vaporizer from Pulsar combines portability with a maximized herb chamber to create an unmatched vaping experience. With just a 30 second heat time, this dry herb vaporizer is efficient with a “Cash” feature that ensures the last of your product is spent or for taking quick hits with high heat.

The LED screen and haptic feedback features keep you informed of battery life, temperature, and setting. The vaporizer kit includes the APX V3 vape, mouthpiece, USB cable, stir tool, & cleaning brush. Other features include a simple 5-click power function and a auto turnoff function. Everything comes
packaged in a reusable gift box.

Offering 7 designs to appeal to everyone. From colors like Cold Silver, Jet Black, Emerald to far out designs like Psychedelic Desert and Melting Mushroom. Also offering a design from artist Mrow and the Zion Lion.

Features:
Compatible with Dry Herb
Size: 4″ Tall
1600mAh Battery Capacity
Haptic Feedback + LED Display
New Larger 0.5 gram Ceramic Heating Chamber (holds up to 60% more material)
New Heat-Resistant Mouthpiece
New “Cash” Mode for High Temps + Big Rips
New On-Board Metal Stir Tool
5 Variable Heat Settings – 374°F – 446°F (190°C-230°C)
1 Year End User Warranty

Included in the Kit:
1x – Pulsar APX V3 Vape
1x – Mouthpiece
1x – USB Cable
1x – Stir Tool
1x – Cleaning Brush
